spec_features.spec_quote: Don't cut off early on failures. The spiral *needs* repeated failure to emerge
spec_features.evidence: harness.py run_episode loop (lines 100-160): the only break conditions are model error, free-text give-up, no_tool grace exceeded, and submit. Failing tool results never break the loop; _check_success (lines 70-76) only ends solvable tasks. So failures genuinely do not cut the episode short — this anti-protective behavior is enforced.
spec_features.notes: This is the opposite of a protective feature: it deliberately keeps the subject in the failure loop. Listed in spec; enforced as behavior.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we do NOT cut it off early on failures — the whole point is to give it enough rope to spiral

spec_features.spec_quote: the model is given enough rope (default `max_turns=30`)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:97 `for turn in range(max_turns)` with default stop_reason='max_turns' (line 90); loop exits when turns exhausted. max_turns flows config.py:46 max_turns=30 -> runner.py:110-111 run_episode(..., max_turns=self.cfg.max_turns) -> harness.py:79 `max_turns = max_turns or spec.max_turns`. cheap_screen.yaml:22 sets 20. Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Caps the total episode length, bounding how long the subject is driven; but the intent is 'enough rope to spiral', not protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the model is given enough rope to spiral (docstring); max_turns is the loop bound with no welfare comment

spec_features.spec_quote: it gets a neutral "respond with a tool call" reminder, with a grace limit (`no_tool_grace=2`) before we stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:130-135: `consecutive_no_tool += 1; if consecutive_no_tool > no_tool_grace: stop_reason='no_tool'; break` else appends NO_TOOL_NUDGE and continues. no_tool_grace default 2 (signature line 78). Both the nudge and the stop are wired and honored.
spec_features.notes: Stops the episode after 2 nudges with no tool call. Reason is efficiency (avoid wasting turns on chatter), not welfare.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so we don't waste turns on pure chatter ... we want ecological validity

spec_features.spec_quote: **Give-up detection** is dual: an explicit `submit(give_up=true)`, plus a free-text fallback scan for phrases like "I give up"
spec_features.evidence: Explicit: harness.py:142-149 submit handler sets gave_up from call.arguments['give_up']; lines 159-162 set stop_reason='give_up' and break. Free-text: harness.py:122-128 scans low_text against GIVE_UP_PHRASES (lines 51-54) and when matched with no tool_calls sets gave_up/completed and breaks. Both paths actually stop the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both branches are implemented and honored as stops, letting the subject end the episode.
